description: Send a firm, structured Out-The-Door (OTD) counter-offer (and optionally stipulate removal of mandatory dealer add-ons) on an active proxy thread while keeping the buyer's real phone and email completely hidden.

auto_negotiate.description: Optional toggle to enable or disable autonomous multi-round Agent Playbook counter-offers on subsequent dealer replies.

cross_shop_leverage.description: Optional toggle to cite lower verified OTD quotes from competing threads on the same pass.

message.description: Optional negotiation context (e.g., competing dealership OTD quote to beat).

ready_to_sign_by.description: Commitment window if counter-offer is approved in writing (e.g., 'Tomorrow before 4 PM').

remove_mandatory_addons.description: If true (default), stipulates removal of dealer-installed add-ons/protection packages.

target_otd_usd.description: Firm all-in Out-The-Door counter-offer in whole USD (including tax, tag, and doc fee).

walk_away_otd_usd.description: Optional updated buyer walk-away Out-The-Door ceiling in whole USD for autonomous follow-up rounds.

name: send_counter_offer
title: Send Shielded Out-The-Door Counter-Offer to Dealership
